content: No, that is not accurate. The annual siren test in Switzerland does not always take place on the first Wednesday in March. The siren test is conducted annually, typically in the first half of the year, but the exact date varies and is not fixed to a specific weekday each year. The test is organized by the Federal Office for Civil Protection (FOCP) to ensure that the civil protection sirens are functioning correctly and that the population is familiar with the alarm signals. For the precise date of the next siren test, you should consult the official announcements from the Federal Office for Civil Protection or your local cantonal authorities.
